name: Pastel Sorbet
description: Pastel pink and mint on a pale ground.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v2 from the reviewed prototype's pastel-sorbet anchors. It puts the light accent #bd6590 back to #e477a8 and secondary #608989 back to #6ea8a1, undoing PR 2a's nudges: anchor-v2 solves the signature fill itself. adjustments lists the 16 roles it moves from anchor-v1.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the sets high-contrast-v2 derives from each base set, and print renders the light set.
caveats: Pastel accents carry little weight, so emphasis leans on type and layout.
In light mode the accent and secondary are darkened to #bd6590 and #608989 so the signature fill reaches 3:1, so they read as dusty rose and grey teal more than pastel.
